body: Forward test of the base rate method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.45 (naive base rate 0.55) that: Dixon Technologies confirms that its Vivo JV began production/consolidation in Q4 FY27 (by 31-Mar-2027). Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (Nov-2026): 'Consolidation of Vivo operations is expected to commence from Q4, with significant volumes anticipated for the next financial year'; MD Atul Lall: 'the integration process is on. We target to start production from Q4 of the current fiscal… in the JV we should be doing around 20–21 million' units next year. FY27 smartphone volume ~33–34 mn excluding Vivo. Q2 revenue ₹21,806 cr; EBITDA ex-fair-value gain ₹609 cr; margins hit by mobile PLI-1 expiry and memory prices. Screener OPM 2.7% (Q2 FY27). Noida 1 mn sq ft facility 'almost completed', Q3 start. Reasoning: Base-rate call on 'next-quarter start' promises in EMS: the stated window is the last quarter of the year and integration of a Chinese brand's operations has had a long regulatory path (from memory, the JV was announced in late 2024 — unverified). We put slippage risk above the generic base. Resolution: YES if Dixon's Q4 FY27 results, press release or earnings call states that the Vivo JV commenced commercial production and/or was consolidated (revenue included) in Q4 FY27 (on or before 31-Mar-2027). Statements that it will start in Q1 FY28 or later = NO. Source: Dixon Technologies Q4 FY27 results / earnings call transcript (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-15; score with Brier vs base rate.
